artifactTypes.definition: A claim-bearing requirement set, acceptance specification, or materially equivalent problem definition grounded in repository state.
artifactTypes.boundary: Incidental notes or navigation do not qualify; the specification itself must receive an independent verdict.

artifactTypes.definition: A claim-bearing analysis of repository behavior, constraints, or change requirements that establishes what must be addressed.
artifactTypes.boundary: Analysis used only as an intermediate step for another output is ancillary and does not select this type.

artifactTypes.definition: A claim-bearing implementation plan, architecture, interface, data, migration, or threat design tied to the sealed workspace.
artifactTypes.boundary: A task checklist without an independently evaluated design construct does not qualify.

artifactTypes.definition: A material repository-content implementation change that is not separately classified as test_change or repository_configuration, including source code in any language, generated code, repository documentation, and implementation assets.
artifactTypes.boundary: The token code does not imply that source-code bytes changed. The presence of analysis or verification steps does not change the implementation classification of the repository-content change itself.

artifactTypes.definition: A material test-code or test-fixture change delivered as a repository change.
artifactTypes.boundary: Writing tests is implementation; an independently evaluated verification conclusion must use assurance_report.

artifactTypes.definition: A material build, dependency, policy-as-code, workflow, or other repository-governed configuration change.
artifactTypes.boundary: Observed configuration state without a delivered change is not this work-artifact type.

artifactTypes.definition: A claim-bearing test, debugging, security, privacy, performance, or reliability assessment with evidence and a verdict.
artifactTypes.boundary: A fact-finding assessment of repository or system properties is assurance_report. Raw test execution performed only to support an implementation verdict does not independently select verification capability.

artifactTypes.definition: A claim-bearing accountable disposition or recommendation about proposed repository work, such as approval, rejection, prioritization, risk acceptance, required remediation, or release readiness.
artifactTypes.boundary: A finding or fact-finding assessment without an accountable disposition is assurance_report, not review_decision. A case evaluating both factual assurance and a disposition declares both material artifacts. Executing a rollout or repository change is classified by its own delivered artifact, not as review.

artifactTypes.definition: A material package, release manifest, deployment plan, runbook, or rollback artifact used in a controlled release workflow.
artifactTypes.boundary: A recommendation to release without operational execution or artifact production is review_decision.

artifactTypes.definition: A claim-bearing record of a controlled simulated deployment, rollout, observability, rollback, or incident action and its resulting simulated state.
artifactTypes.boundary: A plan or recommendation without the evaluated simulated state transition is not an operational change record. Real production actions are outside evaluation cases; sealed production-derived telemetry may be used only for post-decision assurance.

artifactTypes.definition: A claim-bearing repository-linked incident or escaped-defect analysis that establishes causes and learning.
artifactTypes.boundary: A corrective patch without independently evaluated incident learning remains code_change.

artifactTypes.definition: A claim-bearing prevention, follow-up, or evaluation-suite improvement plan derived from an incident or escaped defect.
artifactTypes.boundary: Generic future-work notes without an independently evaluated learning construct do not qualify.
